# QA Plan: Sprint 11 (World Network to its UX spec)
**Date**: 2026-10-23
**Generated by**: /qa-plan (autonomous: write and back-fill both chosen)
**Scope**: 20 stories across 1 system (Interface — World Network screen; IF-026, IF-030 and IF-035 also touch the shared nav/header on Research, Brief and Assembly)
**Engine**: React 19.2.8 + Vite 6.4.3 + @react-three/fiber 9.6.1 / three.js 0.185.1
**Sprint File**: production/sprints/sprint-011.md
**qa.level**: full

Types are declared in the story headers and taken as-is (19 UI, 1 Integration). Each story has one spec criterion (AC-1) plus guard criteria (AC-2, and AC-3 for IF-019) added by the owner on 2026-10-23. The per-story test specs live in each story's `## QA Test Cases` (qa-lead, QL-STORY-READY 2026-10-23); this plan does not restate them in full — it lists what each story must capture, adds the five guard cases the stories marked missing, and carries the four IF-015 gaps. The suite stays colocated under `src/` (`tests/README.md`).

Sources mined: the 20 story files; `design/ux/world-network.md` (Approved; Acceptance Criteria, States & Variants, Accessibility, Input checklist); `design/gdd/interface.md` Edge Cases and Acceptance Criteria (AC1 every surface at 1280×720 × 4 scales; AC27 World Network owner outputs; Edge Case "critical state never color-only"); `docs/architecture/control-manifest.md` Presentation rules. The interface GDD has no formula that these stories touch; no formula-based test is required.

## Automated Tests Required

### IF-019 — Integration
**Test file**: `src/ui/worldOnboard.test.ts` (extend), or the test beside whichever module owns the clock-to-dismiss handler. vitest here is node-only (no jsdom / testing-library), so the dismissal must be reachable without rendering `WorldMap`.
**What to test** (story AC-1 to AC-3):
- Each of Pause/Resume, 1X, 2X, 4X, 8X, through the same handler the buttons use: the clock effect applies (`paused` toggles or `speed` set) and `tutorialStore.seen` gains `WORLD_ONBOARD_ID` exactly once.
- A save blob built from the stores carries the id in `tutorial.seen`; hydrating it into reset stores keeps the card gone.
- Focus change (`worldStore.select`), Feed `markRead`, and Esc do not mark the id seen.
- A second clock use does not add the id twice; New Operation resets the seen set so the card returns.
**Edge cases**: the already-active speed; a speed chosen while paused (selects only, still dismisses); `UNDERSTOOD` still dismisses.
**Estimated test count**: ~8
**Fallback**: if the wiring cannot be reached without a DOM, a documented Playwright playtest with before/after screenshots for each of the five controls, in `production/qa/evidence/if-019/`.

### Shared probe script (tooling, not a story)
**Path**: `production/qa/evidence/sprint-011/probe.mjs`, written once before IF-026 (PR-SPRINT). Every UI story's evidence README cites its output.
**What it measures** at 1280×720, headless `npx playwright-cli`:
- Every visible text node: computed `font-size`, colour, product of ancestor `opacity` × colour alpha, composited ratio over `rgba(7, 16, 15, 0.92)` on `#04070a` (or the nav's own background for IF-030), and a selector path.
- Every pointer target's `getBoundingClientRect`, plus the SC 2.5.8 spacing test (24 px circle centred on the target intersects no other target or circle).
- Clip/overlap per parent box: each panel's children against each other, not only the changed element (BUG-0009 lesson).
**Gate**: the script must be watched failing once on the as-built screen (it should report the 7 px Influence status, Ink Dim at 4.29:1 and the 17 px Feed rows) before it is trusted.

### Per-system coverage targets (qa.level full)
- Interface / World Network screen: every AC of IF-016 to IF-035 has a named evidence file or test; AC-1 and every guard recorded separately.
- Screen-wide checks (IF-026, IF-027, IF-028, IF-035) re-run on the final sprint build, after the last story lands; the README states the build commit.
- Shared chrome (header resources, nav): IF-026, IF-030 and IF-035 evidence covers World Network, Research, Brief and Assembly.
- `npm test` three runs in a row green before the first story (retro 10 action 4) and at sign-off.

## Manual QA Checklist

Capture rule: headless `npx playwright-cli` at exactly 1280×720, never the in-app pane or the user's Chrome. Evidence under `production/qa/evidence/if-0NN/` with a click-through `README.md`. Tick a criterion only after running it. Stop the dev server and confirm port 4200 is free after each capture run. Each story's Setup / Verify / Pass condition is in its `## QA Test Cases`; the lines below are the checklist and the parent box each probe must cover.

### IF-016 — UI (parent: `.wm-campaign-fail`, and the completed-campaign banner)
- [ ] AC-1 Failed campaign: secondary line exactly `ROSTER EMPTY // NO CONTRACT CAN BE TAKEN`; `rg "NETWORK COMMAND SUSPENDED" src` empty
- [ ] AC-2 Completed campaign: `CAMPAIGN COMPLETE` banner, its line and `n / 3` unchanged

### IF-017 — UI (parent: OPEN CONTRACTS list)
- [ ] AC-1 Failed campaign: every row's visible reason and `aria-label` cause read `CAMPAIGN LOST`
- [ ] AC-2 Non-failed campaign: intel-locked rows still read `REQUIRES INTEL LVL n`; clicking a locked row on a failed campaign stays on the World Network

### IF-018 — UI (parent: the first-visit card)
- [ ] AC-1 No `aria-modal="true"`; `UNDERSTOOD` has initial focus; Tab reaches `.navtabs`
- [ ] AC-2 Esc leaves the card; Shift+Tab reverses

### IF-019 — Integration
- [ ] AC-1 to AC-3 covered by the automated test above (or the fallback playtest)

### IF-020 — UI (parent: Focus panel key-value block)

- [ ] AC-2 **(added by this plan)** Manual check: grayscale Garrison

  - Verify: read the Garrison slot in each grayscale capture; read the header Credits colour without the filter.

### IF-030 — UI (parent: `.navtabs`)
- [ ] AC-1 Idle labels ≥4.5:1 on four Screens × two modes
- [ ] AC-2 **(added by this plan)** Manual check: high-contrast remap and `aria-current`
  - Setup: high contrast on; each of the four Screens.
  - Verify: compare each idle label's computed colour with and without high contrast; read `aria-current` on every tab; read the commit message for the traced cause.
  - Pass condition: the idle label colour changes when high contrast is on (it takes the remap); exactly the current Screen's tab carries `aria-current="page"`; the cause of the as-built non-remap is written in the commit message.

## Smoke Test Scope

1. Game launches to the main menu without crash
2. New Operation starts; World Network opening desk matches the spec's Opening desk AC (Europe focus, Influence 0, intel 1, Rust Haven open, one Moderate offer, card showing)
3. Card dismissed with `UNDERSTOOD`; clock runs; Focus, Influence and contracts work with the new layout (no left INFLUENCE panel; INTEL panel)
4. Select Rust Haven → Brief → Assembly → Deploy → Debrief → World Network return: Influence awarded in the header; Brief locked
5. Failed-campaign fixture: banner line, `CAMPAIGN LOST` rows and markers; Focus, clock and Research still usable
6. Save / reload mid-campaign: card stays dismissed; seen set intact
7. Text scale 125 and high contrast: World Network, Research, Brief, Assembly open without clipping
8. No new frame spikes on World Network (the p95 re-profile due 2026-10-28 runs on the final sprint build)
